n: int; total number of customers N, unit: customers; must be an integer with N ≥ 1 (N = 1 is valid, N = 0 is invalid input); customer index j is 0-based, taking 0..N-1; the length of every row of alloc_cost must equal N
m_facilities: int; total number of candidate facilities M, unit: count; must be an integer with M ≥ 1 (M = 1 is valid, M = 0 is invalid input); facility index i is 0-based, taking 0..M-1; the length of fixed_cost and the number of rows of alloc_cost must equal M
fixed_cost: list[float]; one-dimensional array over facilities, length must equal M; the i-th element corresponds to facility i (i = 0..M-1); fixed_cost[i] is the fixed cost of opening facility i, unit: currency units, counted in the total cost whenever the facility is opened; each element is a finite non-negative real, may have decimals, may be 0, and integer notation (e.g., 7500) is also valid; negative values, infinity, NaN, null or missing elements, or a length not equal to M, make the input invalid
alloc_cost: list[list[float]]; facility × customer two-dimensional array with M rows and N columns: the outer length must equal M, and the i-th outer element is the row of facility i (i = 0..M-1); each row's length must equal N, and the j-th element within a row corresponds to customer j (j = 0..N-1); alloc_cost[i][j] is the allocation cost when customer j is served entirely by facility i, unit: currency units; it is already the customer's full service cost, there is no demand field, and it is not multiplied by any coefficient; each element is a finite non-negative real, may have decimals, may be 0, and integer notation is also valid; any facility can serve any customer, and there is no special value denoting a forbidden assignment; negative values, infinity, NaN, null or missing elements, an outer length not equal to M, or any row length not equal to N, make the input invalid
